decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement, CH1-020, CHI-011, CHI-001, CHI-021, Heritage Impact Assessment received on the 28th September 2015. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the approved plans, the proposed offices shall only operate between the hours of 8am to 8pm Monday to Friday.
description: Erection of a two storey extension at southern boundary of site
